check.config: 25 CPU layers, -lzm off, no MTP, separate processes (handoff_contig2)

profile_miss.note: CPU time does not scale with CPU picks in llama.cpp's pinned mode; until that cost is found, the 'engine' rows are optimistic

now.label: This box, llama.cpp fit, page-cache table (no MTP)
now.why: measured split: half of the 480 expert picks per token on the CPU

now_mtp.label: Same + MTP drafting (measured)
now_mtp.why: MTP multiplies decode by 1.36 in the paired A/B

profile_llamacpp.label: Software: profile picks VRAM experts, inside llama.cpp (MEASURED)
profile_llamacpp.why: measured [20.28] vs llama.cpp fit [22.1, 21.14] (same flags, interleaved); the model predicted 43.0: llama.cpp's pinned path costs something this model does not see

profile_engine.label: Software: profile + his engine (overlap, no per-layer sync), ESTIMATE, optimistic
profile_engine.why: the CPU's few cold picks run while the GPU works; no hand-off stalls

overlap.label: Software: CPU works while the GPU works (engine change only)
overlap.why: time = max(CPU, GPU) instead of their sum

second_nvme.label: Second NVMe (RAID0)
second_nvme.prefill: faster model load (111 GB) and cold starts
second_nvme.why: no decode gain: 99.97% of expert pages are already in RAM once the table goes through the page cache

ram_128gb.label: 128 GB RAM (+64 GB DDR4, 4 slots)
ram_128gb.prefill: no SSD at all; room for the lossless 102 GB n-gram table or 8-bit experts
ram_128gb.why: decode is CPU-bound, not RAM-bound; RAM buys quality headroom (lossless table, Q8 experts) and a second model, not speed

egpu.label: eGPU 24 GB + your profile, ESTIMATE (needs the engine)
egpu.why: 79% of experts in VRAM serve 98% of coding picks; hidden states cross the x4 link (~10 KB per hop)

egpu_layers.label: eGPU as 7 more whole layers (works in llama.cpp today)
egpu_layers.why: llama.cpp layer split, 17 CPU layers left

cpu_16core.label: 16-core CPU (5950X drop-in)
cpu_16core.why: upper bound: assumes the CPU expert math scales with cores; it is partly RAM-bandwidth bound

npu.label: NPU
npu.why: this desktop has none; an NPU sharing the same DDR4 reads experts no faster than the CPU (memory-bound); a separate NPU box is a network hop like the Mac

mac.label: M4 Mac (16 GB) over Tailscale
mac.why: measured round trip 53 ms average (7.6-302 ms): one hop costs more than a whole token here; give it its own jobs instead

dream.label: Profile + engine + eGPU + MTP, ESTIMATE, optimistic
dream.why: GPU-bound: what is left is the GPUs' own time

note: decode estimates built from measured components (MTP-off arm unless marked); 'profile_engine', 'overlap' and 'dream' need an engine that does not exist yet
